coverage_gaps: Neither language's pick-set includes a dedicated video on process termination mechanics (exit()/wait()) or zombie/orphan processes for the English side (no comparably popular English-language video on zombie/orphan was found; only small-channel English options like Shahid Nihal's 'Zombie Process and Orphan Process' exist, well below the popularity bar). Hinglish picks do cover zombie/orphan via CodeHelp Babbar's Lecture 11. PCB is covered as a dedicated video only for English (Neso's 'Process Control Block' was a close runner-up, not a top-3 pick); Hinglish picks touch PCB only implicitly through fork()/context-switch discussion, not as a dedicated structure walkthrough.
